recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：多個有生發中心的反應性濾泡（follicular hyperplasia），濾泡周圍與間質中散布許多淡粉紅色的小團類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），部分緊貼甚至侵入生發中心，加上被膜下淡染區，構成弓漿蟲淋巴結炎（Piringer-Kuchinka）的典型三聯徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with intact capsule and perinodal fat
Multiple reactive follicles with enlarged pale germinal centers
Numerous small, pale eosinophilic clusters of epithelioid histiocytes in interfollicular areas
Epithelioid clusters abutting and encroaching on germinal centers
Pale subcapsular/perisinusoidal zones suggestive of monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
No necrosis or well-formed large granulomas
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows preserved architecture with a thin capsule and follicular hyperplasia with enlarged germinal centers. Numerous small, loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are scattered in the interfollicular areas and encroach upon germinal centers, and pale subcapsular zones suggest monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia. Necrosis and well-formed large granulomas are absent. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis (Piringer-Kuchinka lymphadenitis), best confirmed with serology.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are larger, well formed and often necrotizing with giant cells, rather than tiny non-necrotizing epithelioid clusters encroaching on follicles.
Sarcoid granulomas are discrete, tight and confluent, replacing the node, without the florid follicular and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia of toxoplasmosis.
Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back crowded follicles with attenuated mantles and no tingible-body macrophages, and lacks epithelioid histiocyte clusters.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes
ddx.vs: NLPHL shows large vague nodules containing LP (popcorn) cells that are CD20+ and CD30-, rather than reactive follicles with polarized germinal centers.
